name: add-to-github-project
description: Automatically adds issues and PRs to a GitHub project

scripts.build: npm run fix && npm run check && npm run build:compile
scripts.build:package: npm run regex:fix && npm run package
scripts.bundle: npm run build && npm run build:package
scripts.package:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Packaging project...' && rimraf ./dist && rollup --config rollup.config.ts --configPlugin typescript
scripts.package:watch:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Packaging project in watch mode...' && npm run package -- --watch
scripts.clean: npm run clean:modules && npm run clean:cache
scripts.clean:modules:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Cleaning node_modules and package-lock.json...' && rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json
scripts.clean:cache:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Cleaning npm cache...' && npm cache clean --force
scripts.coverage:badge:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Generating coverage badge...' && npm run badge
scripts.coverage:summary: npm run command:jq:check && npm run coverage:jq:summary || npm run command:jq:notfound
scripts.coverage:jq:summary:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Coverage summary totals...' && cat coverage/coverage-summary.json | (jq -c .total 2>/dev/null || printf '\033[1;31m(X) %s\033[0m
' 'Failed to parse coverage summary.')
scripts.command:jq:notfound:
printf '\033[1;33m(!) %s\033[0m
' '`jq` not found, skipping coverage summary.'
scripts.pretest:
npm run coverage:purge && printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Running tests with coverage...'
scripts.postinstall:
npm run regex:fix && printf '\033[1;32m%s: %s\033[0m
' 'Installation complete' 'Run `npm run build` to build the project.'
scripts.all: npm run reset && npm test && npm run bundle && npm run coverage:badge
